Acchāvākaśastra
Peters. IV. 2 (Extr.). Ujjain I. p. 17 (2 mss.) (one ms. Rātriparyāya). Weber 117.

Acchidrapraśna
veda. PUL. II. App. p. 2.

Acchidrapraśna
the VII Praśna of the III Aṣṭaka of the Taitt. Brāhmaṇa; so-called because it speaks of Prāyaścittas to make up for the short-comings in a Yajña. Adyar. Gov. Or. Libr. Madras 2.

Acchidrasaṃhitā
from Śivarahasya, q. in Vaṭukārcanasaṅgraha of Bālambhaṭṭa, RASB. VIII. B. 6466.

Acchidrāśvamedha
the VII, VIII an. IX Praśnas of the Taitt. Brāhmaṇa. MD. 15889. Oppert I. 1735. II. 5656.

Ācchaṇṇa
Dig. Jain writer of Purīkaranagara, c. 1195 A. D., son of Brahman parents, Keśavarāja an. Mallāmbikā; pupil of Nandiyogīśvara.
--Completed the Vardhamāna Purāṇa begun by his father. See Tank, Dict. of Jaina Biography, p. 20.
